project_type: Python RAG pipeline with Telegram bot, LangGraph, and multi-worker orchestration scripts
build_system: uv (PEP 735 dependency groups), Makefile for targets
test_framework: pytest with pytest-xdist (parallel), pytest-asyncio, strict markers, pythonpath=['.']
verification_instructions: 1. Run `make check` (ruff lint + mypy type-check). 2. Run `uv run pytest tests/unit/scripts/test_swarm_validate_signal.py tests/unit/scripts/test_swarm_reserved_guard.py tests/unit/scripts/test_swarm_lifecycle.py -q --timeout=30` to validate new tests. 3. Run full unit suite `make test-unit` for regression.
setup_instructions: 1. `uv sync` to install dev dependencies. 2. Confirm pytest works: `uv run pytest tests/unit/ -q --timeout=30 -x --co` (collect only).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No Docker daemon needed for unit tests. Scripts must not import from telegram_bot/ or mini_app/ runtime modules (per scripts/AGENTS.override.md). Use only stdlib + pydantic for script validation logic.
contribution_requirements: Branch from `dev`. Test-first workflow (TDD). Include verification evidence. Run `make check` + `uv run pytest tests/unit -q` before completion. PR targets `dev`.
key_patterns: Scripts in scripts/ are standalone CLI tools with if __name__=='__main__' entry points. Tests in tests/unit/scripts/ import from scripts module directly (pythonpath=['.']). Tests use pathlib, tmp_path fixtures, monkeypatch. No external service dependencies in unit tests. Scripts use argparse or simple main() returning int exit codes. Fixtures go in tests/fixtures/. Empty __init__.py in scripts/ and tests/unit/scripts/.
directory_structure: scripts/ - standalone Python/bash tools; tests/unit/scripts/ - unit tests for scripts; tests/fixtures/ - test fixture data (compose.ci.env, config.py, data.py, retrieval/); .signals/ - session-local worker signals (gitignored, not committed)
